title: HealthCheck
description: A complex type that contains information about a health check.

Id.description: The identifier that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the health check.

CallerReference.description: A unique string that you specified when you created the health check.

IPAddress.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 IP address of the endpoint to check.

Port.description: The port on the endpoint to check.

ResourcePath.description: The path to request when performing health checks.

FullyQualifiedDomainName.description: The fully qualified domain name of the endpoint to check.

RequestInterval.description: The number of seconds between health checks of the endpoint.

FailureThreshold.description: The number of consecutive health checks that must fail before Route 53 considers the endpoint unhealthy.

EnableSNI.description: Whether to send the value of FullyQualifiedDomainName to the endpoint in the client_hello message during TLS negotiation.

HealthCheckVersion.description: The version of the health check.
